column1: # CodeBrix.LilyPort glyph-identity index -- generated by generate-glyph-identity.py.
# Maps the sha256 of a NORMALIZED glyph outline to the glyph NAME it
# belongs to, separately for each side, so compare-output.py can grade a
# music glyph by name instead of by the serialization of whichever font
#   any run of whitespace -> a single space, then strip. The fonts are read
#   with ElementTree, so XML attribute-value normalization (newline, CR and
#   tab inside an attribute value become a space) has already been applied
#   by the same code that applies it to pages.
# Hashes only -- no outline and no font file from either side is
# redistributed here, and the comparator never reads a font.
# SOURCE FONTS (sha256 of each file as read)
